# Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack

- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatedanimatedcharacter.html
- Edition: November 2019 free pack
- Creator: Quaternius
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Retrieved: 2026-07-13

## Project Import

This project retains 13 of the 52 characters as self-contained glTF files
(buffers embedded, no external textures): the exclusive player character
`Suit_Male` plus twelve civilians for the pedestrian crowd (Casual family,
Worker, OldClassy, Suit_Female). Each file carries the shared rig and the
full animation set (Idle, Walk, Run, SitDown, and more). The duplicate FBX,
OBJ, and Blend exports are omitted; further characters can be copied from
the source download when needed.

Project-owned prefabs, animator controllers, and integration code live under
`Assets/_Project`; do not edit the imported files in place.
